note: Registry of external proof artifacts. Artifacts are downloaded by scripts/fetch_proof_artifacts.py, SHA-256 + byte-length verified BEFORE use, and never committed to git. A DOI is provenance metadata only; download_url must be the exact file-level transport locator. sha256/bytes stay null until the frozen publication provides the exact content identity; while null, the entry is UNFETCHED and full replay hard-fails (activation gate: populating them flips full_artifact_replay from BLOCKED only when the same identity appears in the frozen publication metadata).
